summary: E2E frontend testing of Phase 2 Partner Portal: Store Context Banner + enhanced Team CRUD. 7/10 tests PASS. TEST 7, 8, 9 FAIL due to a real BACKEND permission bug — PATCH and DELETE /api/partner/staff/{id} require role 'owner' only, but UI (and product spec) allow managers to change role / deactivate / remove teammates. Manager1 gets 403 on those calls.

critical.issue: Returns 403 for logged-in manager. Dependency require_role('owner') should be require_role('owner','manager') per product spec and UI (canManage = owner||manager in TeamPage.jsx). Blocks role change and deactivate/reactivate for managers.
Same as above — require_role('owner') should include 'manager'. Blocks Remove teammate for managers.

ui_bugs.issue: No data-testid on the modal close (X) button and no data-testid='invite-close'. Makes automated modal dismissal fragile. On invite-success screen, only 'Invite another' + X icon are present.
Save button lacks data-testid (e.g., team-role-save-{email}). The review request references team-role-save- selector which does not exist in code.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend allows manager to click these actions but backend returns 403; user only sees an error toast. Either restrict UI to owner-only or fix backend perms (recommended per spec).

rca of the issue: Bug: Manager cannot change role, deactivate, or remove teammates. Repro: Login as manager1@example.com on MRT-ABJ-001 → Team page → click 'Change role' on any non-self row → change select and Save → observe 403 in network for PATCH /api/partner/staff/{id}. Same for Deactivate and Remove buttons. Root cause: staff_routes.py PATCH and DELETE endpoints use `require_role('owner')` while POST /invite uses `require_role('owner','manager')`. Mitigation: change decorator to include 'manager' (line 576 & 596) OR reduce UI canManage to owner-only in TeamPage.jsx.
